column1: # Clues written for CrossWordle in the style of a British quick crossword (the Guardian Quick,
# the Times Quick): short definitions and synonyms, a few fill-in-the-blanks, two meanings joined
# by a dash, the odd playful one. Original work, not copied from any newspaper.
# The answers are about 3,000 of the most familiar words in the pool, ranked by how many senses
# Open English WordNet gives them. Daily puzzles only use answers clued here. See README.md for the
# style guide. Hand edits and exclusions go in edits.tsv, which overrides this file.
